summary: The chrome, timeline/gantt data-plane, and top-level tab/badge grammar match the prototype closely and are wired to real live data (SSE session-trace + agent-tasks + artifacts + mcp/servers + context/state). But roughly half the surface's finer-grained truth is off: the tools tab renders a structurally wrong view (a static per-server tool catalog instead of the prototype's chronological tool-call log) AND that wrong view is itself broken (every tool name renders blank, a string/object type mismatch against /v1/mcp/servers); the runs tab is a flat ungrouped list missing the RUNNING/COMPLETED grouping, status icons, and transcript links; the context tab is missing its progress bar, 3-metric KPI grid, and 'live now' panel (only used%/tokens survive); and the prototype's entire cross-navigation model — click a log/gantt/runs/tools/artifacts row to jump to that message, open that agent's transcript, or open that artifact — has zero equivalent anywhere in the shipped panel.

items.element: Legend glyph row: ○ event · (icon) tool · ◆ artifact · ✗ failure · ● running
items.proto_truth: prototype markup (HTML offset ~8239011): event = plain '○' text muted; TOOL = an 11x11 circle with 1px border, containing an orange (var(--t-ac)) wrench SVG icon — not a text character; artifact = '◆' colored var(--t-cy) cyan; failure = '✗' (U+2717) colored var(--t-er) red; running = '●' colored var(--t-ac) orange
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx:15-21 GLYPHS = {event:'○', tool:'◉', artifact:'◆', failure:'×', running:'●'}; observability.css:140-158 only overrides color for artifact/failure/running kinds — tool legend glyph stays default muted gray text, no orange, no circle, no wrench icon at all; failure uses '×' (U+00D7) not '✗' (U+2717)
items.fix_hint: Render the tool marker as the same orange circled-wrench SVG used per-row (see next finding) instead of a muted text glyph; swap '×' for '✗' to match the exact codepoint.

items.element: Timeline log row glyph/marker per kind (thread bullet)
items.proto_truth: prototype per-row markers (HTML offset ~8242700+): generic event = 11px ring with dynamic border color; artifact = 8x8 diamond, cyan fill, outlined; failure = bold red '✗' text; RUNNING = 11px filled orange circle that PULSES via `animation: clio-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite`; USER = a distinct 16x16 circle containing a person/head-and-shoulders SVG icon; TOOL = a distinct 16x16 circle containing an orange wrench SVG icon
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx:272-274 (`{GLYPHS[row.kind]}`) renders the same 5 flat GLYPHS characters used in the legend, no SVG icons, and no 'user' kind exists at all in ObsTimelineKind (apps/web/src/observability/types.ts:38); observability.css:203-215 has no animation/keyframe applied to .obs-log__node for the running state
items.fix_hint: Add a 'user' timeline kind with its own icon; add the clio-pulse animation to the running marker; render tool as the wrench-in-circle icon.

items.element: Timeline's opening row for the user's turn
items.proto_truth: prototype's very first log row is always the user message, e.g. '19:52 · user · "What recent ground-motion is EarthScope's GNSS network showing around..."' (proto-obs.json rows[0-1])
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/build.ts:148-227 `toHistoryTimelineRow` only produces rows for part types 'expert_handoff', 'tool_call', 'background_exit', and artifact parts — there is no branch for a plain user/assistant text part, so the user's question never becomes a timeline row; confirmed live: apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/obs-timeline-live.png opens directly on '12:16 geospatial task started' even though the visible transcript behind the panel clearly shows a user question first
items.backend_surface: GET /v1/sessions/{id}/messages (message.parts already carry the user text; build.ts just never converts it to a row)
items.fix_hint: Add a text/user-message branch to toHistoryTimelineRow so the first user turn (and subsequent user turns) appear as 'user' kind rows.

items.element: Timeline/gantt/runs/tools/artifacts row click-to-navigate (jump to message / open agent transcript / open artifact)
items.proto_truth: prototype's obsTl row builder (HTML offset ~8472858) wraps every row in a click handler keyed by row type: `r.jumpMsg` → closes the observability layer and scrolls the transcript to that message (title 'Go to message'); `r.isArt` → `this.artGo(r.name)` (title 'Open artifact'); rows naming a child agent → `this.goView(jk)` (title 'Open agent'); cursor is dynamically 'pointer' vs 'default' depending on whether a handler exists
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx — Timeline() (lines 233-296) and Gantt() (lines 298-370) render plain `<li>`/`<div>` rows with zero onClick handlers anywhere in the file; no equivalent of jump-to-message, open-agent, or open-artifact exists for log or gantt rows
items.backend_surface: unbacked (no client-side navigation wired; underlying data — message ids, child_session_id, artifact ids — is already present in the parts/records used to build these rows)
items.fix_hint: Wire onClick handlers on log/gantt rows: scroll-to-message for handoff/tool rows tied to a sourceId, open child session for expert_handoff rows (task.child_session_id is already read in build.ts), open the artifact viewer for artifact rows.

items.element: Gantt chart: hierarchical indented rows, teal duration bars, tool glyphs, artifact diamond markers, orange running bars, time axis
items.proto_truth: proto-obs-gantt.png: axis ticks every ~2min; nested rows (main·turn1 > geospatial > data > ndp_dataset_discovery > ...) each indented by depth; cyan bars with duration labels to the right; orange gradient/shimmer bars for 'running' rows (turn 2, data x2); a small ✗ inline on a running bar to flag a nested failure
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx:298-370 Gantt(); observability.css:254-380 (.obs-gantt__bar[data-state=running] shimmer keyframe, [data-state=failed] red); build.ts:260-397 reconstructPartSpans/toTaskSpan build real spans from live parts+agent tasks; verified live: apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/obs-gantt-live.png renders a real red-bordered failed bar with '1m 57s' duration for the live geospatial task

items.element: Runs tab: RUNNING / COMPLETED (N) grouped sections, per-row lightning-bolt (running, orange) or checkmark (done, green) icon, description line, 'live transcript ↗' / 'transcript ↗' link opening that run's session
items.proto_truth: proto-obs-runs.png + prototype markup (HTML offset ~8250560): 'RUNNING' uppercase small-caps header, each row a full-width `<button>` (not static text) with an orange lightning-bolt SVG, run label, host/task id, 'running · Xh Ym' state, a second description line, and a cyan 'live transcript ↗' action; 'COMPLETED (4)' section below uses a green ✓ SVG per row and a 'transcript ↗' action instead
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx:125-144 renders a single flat `<ul>` of `obs-run__row` `<li>` items (id/agent/state/host/duration in a 5-column CSS grid) with no grouping, no status icon, no description, no transcript link, and not a button; observability.css:436-486 confirms plain text styling only; live capture apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/obs-runs-live.png shows one bare row: 'geospatial #1 / task_dde2adc566e9 ... geospatial  failed  local  1m 57s'
items.fix_hint: Group taskRuns by running vs terminal state, add status icon + description + a transcript link that opens the run's child_session_id (already present on SessionAgentTask).

items.element: Tools tab information model: chronological log of tool CALLS made this session
items.proto_truth: proto-obs-tools.png + prototype markup (HTML offset ~8256338, `obsToolRows`): each row = time, orange wrench icon, an expandable `<button>` showing `name(argHint) ▸` that toggles inline call details, a cyan '{{agent}} ↗' button that opens the session where the call ran, and a trailing ✓/✗/pulsing-running status glyph — 14 rows total for the captured session, sorted by call time
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx:146-170 renders a completely different view: an 'Expert' <Select> dropdown scoped to one MCP server at a time, plus a static description list of that server's declared tools — there is no time column, no call args, no expand/collapse, no per-call status, and no per-call agent link anywhere in the file
items.backend_surface: unbacked as designed (mcp/servers describes available tools, not session tool-call history; the actual call history already exists in the timeline's tool_call parts, see build.ts:185-197, and is simply not projected into this tab)
items.fix_hint: Rebuild the tools tab from the same tool_call/tool_result parts + resultByCall map already computed in build.ts's buildObservabilityTrace, instead of client.mcpServers().

items.element: Tools tab rows (within the current, wrong catalog model) — tool name/description text
items.proto_truth: n/a — measuring only whether the app's own chosen data renders; the tab badge correctly reads 'tools 4' and the per-server meta correctly reads '3 tools' for 'fs'
items.app_evidence:
apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx:251-266 maps `(row.tools ?? []).map((tool) => ({ name: tool.name ?? '', ... }))`, but GET /v1/mcp/servers returns `tools` as an array of plain strings (e.g. `["fs_apply_edit_write","fs_propose_edit","fs_read_file"]`), not `{name, description}` objects — `tool.name` on a string is always `undefined`, so every row renders `''`; confirmed live via DOM dump: `
    • ` x3, and via `curl http://127.0.0.1:17900/v1/mcp/servers` showing `"tools": ["fs_apply_edit_write", ...]` (string[])
items.fix_hint: Map `tool` as the string itself (`{ name: tool }`) rather than `tool.name`, or fix the wire type to match whichever side is correct; a blank name for every row is a total loss of information regardless of which tab layout ships.

items.element: Artifacts tab row click-to-open (entire row is a button)
items.proto_truth: prototype markup (HTML offset ~8266125): each artifact row is a full-width `<button sc-camel-on-click="{{goArtCat}}" ...>` — the whole row opens the artifact viewer, not just the name
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx:176-188 renders `<li className="obs-artifact__row">` containing plain `<span>` elements (time/glyph/name/producer/meta) — no `<button>`, no onClick anywhere in the artifacts branch

items.fix_hint: Wrap the row in a button/onClick that opens the same artifact viewer the 'artifacts N' topbar chip and inline transcript artifact chips already use.

items.element: Context tab: context-window progress bar with 'Xk / Yk · Z%' label
items.proto_truth: proto-obs-context.png + measured JSON: 'context window' label left, '82.1k / 200k · 41%' right (11.5px mono, value in header color); below it a 6px rounded bar, teal→blue gradient fill at 41% width
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx:203-219 renders a generic `<KvGrid>` with two flat rows: 'used: N%' and 'tokens: X / Y' — no visual progress-bar element, no combined 'Xk/Yk · Z%' single-line format; live capture apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/obs-context-live.png shows exactly 'used 0%' / 'tokens 1,755 / 1,000,000' as plain KV text
items.fix_hint: Replace the KvGrid with a dedicated context-window component: one combined label line + a gradient progress bar sized to usedPercent.

items.element: Context tab: 3-column KPI grid — relay latency (green ms) / thinking tokens (white count) / cost (cyan $)
items.proto_truth: proto-obs-context.png: three bordered cards in a row, each with an uppercase small-caps label, a 16px value ('12 ms' green, '600' white, '$0.31' cyan), and a muted caption line ('clio-relay (ares)', '2 blocks', 'incl. subagents')
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/types.ts:32-36 ObsContext only has {usedPercent, tokens, limit} — there is no relay-latency, thinking-tokens, or cost field anywhere in the type or in Observability.tsx's context branch (lines 203-219)
items.backend_surface: GET /v1/sessions/{id}/context/state (unknown whether the backend response even carries relay latency / thinking-token / cost figures — needs a wire-shape check before this can be wired, since related task #1176/#7 already flags a 422 on this same route in some session-mode paths)
items.fix_hint: Confirm /context/state's actual payload includes these three metrics (or find the routes that do — usage.py/evidence.py per CLAUDE.md's gact module map) and extend ObsContext + the render branch.

items.element: Context tab: 'LIVE NOW · N' panel listing concurrently-running background jobs
items.proto_truth: proto-obs-context.png: a bordered box titled 'LIVE NOW · 3' followed by 3 orange-text rows, e.g. 'stripe-tuner · getstripe 6,143/9,800 · 12.4k tok ↑' and two rows prefixed with a lightning-bolt glyph ('⚡ io-monitor · sampling every 30s · last 08s ago')
items.app_evidence: No equivalent list, data source, or UI exists anywhere in apps/web/src/observability/ — the context branch renders only the two-row KvGrid described above
items.backend_surface: unbacked (would need a cross-session 'what else is running right now' feed, distinct from GET /v1/sessions/{id}/context/state which is scoped to one session)
items.fix_hint: Out of scope for a single-session context/state call; would need a new session-agnostic 'active runs' endpoint, or reuse of GET /v1/sessions with a running-status filter.
